configurePresets.name: windows-core
configurePresets.displayName: Windows core (libaicad, Ninja + MSVC, OCCT off)
configurePresets.description: Configure the C++ core with MSVC. Run from an 'x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS 2022' (or after vcvars64.bat) so cl/link are on PATH. OCCT off = the self-contained fast build; verified on Win11 + MSVC 14.44. See docs/BUILD_WINDOWS.md.

configurePresets.name: windows-occt
configurePresets.displayName: Windows core + OCCT (libaicad, Ninja + MSVC, OCCT on)
configurePresets.description: Configure the C++ core with the OCCT geometry kernel + Netgen mesher on MSVC. First configure auto-downloads OCCT 7.9.3 (~250 MB) and builds Netgen once (cached under third_party/). Run from an 'x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS 2022'. Verified on Win11 + MSVC 14.44: clean build, 48/49 ctest. See docs/BUILD_WINDOWS.md.

configurePresets.name: windows-app
configurePresets.displayName: Windows app (ImGui GUI, Ninja + MSVC)  [T-G11 — agent-verified]
configurePresets.description: Configure the cross-platform ImGui GUI (ui/imgui/) on Windows. Mirrors 'linux-app'; ui/imgui/CMakeLists.txt carries the WIN32 link block (opengl32/dwmapi/comdlg32) + the SHELL:/FI fix_math.h force-include (fixed for Ninja under T-G11 — the plain /FI"path" form embedded literal quotes and hit C1083). Run from an 'x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS 2022'. The app dlopens libaicad at runtime — build 'windows-occt' first so libaicad.dll exists. STATUS: agent-verified 2026-07-06 (opus-sweep, MSVC 14.44) — configure+build clean (0 errors) and the binary runs headless (--shot → 1616x1039 PNG). A HUMAN interactive smoke (open part / sketch / extrude / save) is still required for the T-G11 host/-deletion gate. See docs/BUILD_WINDOWS.md.
